mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at the Military Ridge State Trail with a temperature of 66 degrees.

Mayor Diaz has officially proclaimed October as Community Planning Month to recognize the vital work of our planning department. Additionally, the city is promoting a wonderful tri-shaw Bike program for seniors, which offers free rides along the Military Ridge State Trail to enjoy nature and our local scenery.
There is a busy schedule ahead with the Dane County Farmers Market taking place today, followed by the World Dairy Expo and the Farley Center Fall Festival both happening tomorrow.
On September 21, officers identified a suspect through surveillance footage who had committed a retail theft of candy from a store on East Verona Avenue.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Really Reese's, and since the restaurant is currently open until 10:30 PM, I encourage you to head over and grab a scoop.
